import json
n=30
g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
# preserve/construct outer 5 frame
for c in range(1,26): g[1][c]=5; g[25][c]=5
for r in range(1,26): g[r][1]=5; g[r][25]=5
# 2 fills between the outer frame and an inset-2 inner 5 frame
for r in range(2,25):
 for c in range(2,25):
  if not (3<=r<=23 and 3<=c<=23): g[r][c]=2
# inner square border
for c in range(3,24): g[3][c]=5; g[23][c]=5
for r in range(3,24): g[r][3]=5; g[r][23]=5
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':g},separators=(',',':')))
